execute-phase.md.reason: #3829: code_review_gate gains the two behaviours approved on the issue — it reports the per-severity counts REVIEW.md already carries (previously parsed into the same range and discarded), and it records a per-finding disposition so a triaged finding is distinguishable from a forgotten one. Almost all of that lands in a new lazily-read step file, gsd-core/workflows/execute-phase/steps/code-review-disposition.md; this file grows only by the paragraph that reads and executes it. Extraction rather than inline growth is deliberate: execute-phase.md sits against two independent ceilings — the XL hard cap in tests/workflow-size-budget.test.cjs and the frozen ADR-857 pre-phase-6 ceiling in tests/claude-orchestration.test.cjs — and both are red lines to stay under, not budgets to spend.
